name: bearing-diligence
description: Private research over public meeting records, run on your own computer.

scripts.test: npm run build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron scripts/test-run.mjs
scripts.gates: npm run build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron dist/src/gates/run.js
scripts.prove: npm run build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron dist/src/gates/run.js --prove
scripts.senses: npm run build && python3 scripts/checks.py && python3 scripts/checks.py --prove
scripts.ui: npm run build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron dist/tools/ui-dev/serve.js
scripts.ingest: npm run build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron dist/src/cli/ingest.js
scripts.ask: npm run build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron dist/src/cli/ask.js
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run gates && npm run prove && npm run senses && npm run smoke && npm run counts
scripts.probes: npm run build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron dist/test/probes-run.js
scripts.deletion-pass: npm run build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron scripts/deletion-pass.mjs
scripts.watch-calls: npm run build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron tools/watch-calls.mjs
scripts.models: npm run build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron dist/src/cli/models.js
